name: Daughter of the Sea
source:
Mermaids and humans are from two different worlds but when a human prince falls in love with a woman he doesn’t know is a mermaid, their worlds come crashing together.

Source: https://episodeinteractive.com/r/s/i/5509174207479808
translation:
美人鱼和人类来自两个不同的世界，但当一位人类王子爱上了一个他不知道是美人鱼的女人时，他们的世界崩溃了。

来源：https://episodeinteractive.com/r/s/i/5509174207479808
